normalization_review.status: proposal only; not approved or applied by this network review
normalization_review.reason: Raw baselines use CRLF and development witnesses contain both inherited CRLF and added LF lines. A shared all-LF template cannot honestly claim raw byte reconstruction without an exact normalization policy or byte-preserving template mechanism.
normalization_review.proposed_policy: Reuse sfm:java_lf_final_newline@1 for exactly these six raw blobs: CRLF to LF only; all already have final LF, so lf_added is false. Reject BOM, lone CR, token/comment/other whitespace changes.
normalization_review.other_paths: No blanket newline normalization permission. SFMPackets, SFMPacketDaddy and all added paths require their own raw line-ending evidence during authoring.
